verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted inference API and its SDKs. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out control, data-retention setting, or tracking toggle. The SDK's TCP-warming requests are a latency optimization, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
